title: First screen: a composited street scene with an original character, the brand sticker, the tilted download sticker and a platform line; its layer contract renders the scene at 1920 x 1080, 1080 x 1920 and 920 x 430 from one set of layers
use: The key visual of a street-tape game site and its store sizes. The scene and the character are layers: materials request writes the character's generation task sheet, materials composite builds the ground (scene, shadows) and the upper image (character, fx, foreground) for every declared size; this template sets the live type over them.

stripes.note: stripe band on the right edge

scene.note: materials composite <WxH>-ground.png: bg, ghost type, mid plates and the character's shadows; the text ground

figure.note: materials composite <WxH>-upper.png: the character with its outline, fx and the foreground occluder

platforms.default: PC 启动器下载（Windows 10 64 位及以上）

layers.note: Plates are full design-space images (1440 x 1014 units, any resolution); boxes, feet and type boxes are output pixels of each size. Pixel parameters of the integration modes are written for a 1080 px short side and scaled by pxScale (default short side / 1080).

stack.note: outlined ghost numerals; never carries information
street: skyline, shop front, awning, washers, vending machine, pavement
type behind the figure (an allowed sandwich; the title stays in front)
brand sticker, download sticker, platform line: live text, always last

char.use: full-figure original character, standing, three-quarter view
char.facing: three-quarter, turned to frame right (toward the shop front)

relations: Scene frame 1440 x 1014 at (200, 66) with its lower-left corner cut along the 49-degree line; grey band on the left, stripe band on the right.
Brand sticker top-left at (236, 96), download sticker top-right at (1236, 150), platform line on the pavement at y 1044; the character's foot at (700, 990), 880 px tall, between them.
The face and hands stay out of every type box and the foreground occluder at every size (materials composite checks the declared boxes, template check the rendered ink).
decoration: Stripe band and the cassette mark of the brand sticker: drawn. Scene plates, the character and the foreground are layers (materials composite).

provenance.corpus: replay-ward case (回放街区 REPLAY WARD): our own original one-page game site and two in-game screens in the street-tape grammar
provenance.experiment: issue #311 compositing prototype: the case's first screen rebuilt as layers, a CC0 stand-in figure (Cleveland Museum of Art 1972.368.6) composited sticker and painted at three sizes and measured
provenance.method: The case's first screen without its character (?show=1) split into plates by the case's own drawing functions; the layer stack, per-size frames, crops, sprite boxes, the character slot and the type boxes are the prototype's layers.json after its two safe-area fixes (the steam occluder moved off the left hand, the vertical brand sticker off the face).
measured: Prototype: black-point difference +0.060 untreated, +0.017 sticker, -0.001 painted; mean dE 21.5 / 16.8 / 13.6 (hero).
Prototype: defringe cut the backdrop-coloured edge from 2.15 to 1.18 px; two real safe-area faults found and fixed (occluder over a hand 76%, brand sticker over the face).
